adminMessage.title: Admin Message
adminMessage.description: Internal error detail for admins. Do not show to the user.

contextMessage.title: Context Message
contextMessage.description: User-facing message explaining the existing context found for this question.

contextRecordsJson.title: Context Records JSON
contextRecordsJson.description: JSON list of existing context records returned by SmartIntake. Use for planner reasoning or custom

contextType.title: Context Type
contextType.description: Type of existing context returned, such as a matched record or previous booking context.

errorCode.title: Error Code
errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code for debugging failed context lookup.

errorType.title: Error Type
errorType.description: Category of error when success is false.

hasContext.title: Has Context
hasContext.description: True when existing context is available for the current question or matched record.

success.title: Success
success.description: True when the existing context lookup completed successfully.

userMessage.title: User Message
userMessage.description: User-facing context or error message. Show this when present.
